name: Marig-on Marathon 2026
short_description: A full marathon and multi-distance race set for September 20, 2026 in Catarman, Northern Samar, Philippines.
ai_summary: The Marig-on Marathon 2026 is a full marathon event scheduled for September 20, 2026, in Catarman, Northern Samar, Philippines. Organized by the Marig-on Norte Samarnon Eagles Club, the event offers four distance options: 42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km. Registration details have not yet been announced.
